_meta.basis: Reuses ../govt-exam-reminders/competitors.json and core_loop_competitors.md (same audience/category) and adds a v2-specific check of Pro features (post-application tracking, persistent reminders, paid tiers).
_meta.data_caveats: Play Store, AppGoblin, TrueJobs and GovFitAI pages could not be fetched (DNS-blocked in this environment). Feature/price claims come from search snippets of store listings. Step-3 review mining (20x1-star, 20x3-star, 10x5-star per competitor) was NOT possible — complaint themes are secondary/inferred, same gap as v1.

indirect_competitors.name: DigiLocker (govt)

emerging_threats.name: Edtech incumbents adding 'My applications' tracking
emerging_threats.notes: Not observed yet, but they already hold target-exam profiles for tens of millions; a tracker is a sprint-sized feature. Stage = hypothetical, labelled 'announced' only for schema.

emerging_threats.name: Indie entrants (SarkariFilled, GovFitAI, Sarkari Scan, India Govt Job Finder, Naukri Alert)
emerging_threats.notes: At least 5 small indie products launched 2025-2026 around eligibility/autofill — the angle is obvious to builders; expect copycats of any working feature.

emerging_threats.name: Official app consolidation (mySSC; other boards may follow)
emerging_threats.notes: Board-native status notifications erode lifecycle-tracker value board by board.

review_mining_summary.most_common_complaint_across_competitors: Noise + untrustworthiness (ads, upsell, clone sites, irrelevant alerts) — inferred from secondary sources; no systematic star-bucket mining possible.
review_mining_summary.strongest_gap_signal: No product found combines true eligibility matching (age-on-cutoff with relaxations, domicile) + persistent until-applied reminders + per-application lifecycle tracking. Post-application tracking exists only as a free web tool (TrueJobs).

positioning_gaps.description: Per-application lifecycle tracker (city slip -> DV) tied to the user's own applications
positioning_gaps.evidence: Not found in any app; TrueJobs web tracker exists free; incumbents could add it quickly.

positioning_gaps.description: Zero-noise feed: only true matches, reminder persists until 'applied'/'not interested', complete what-you-need card
positioning_gaps.evidence: core_loop_competitors.md: each piece exists separately, not combined; accuracy of per-notification rules is the real moat (operationally hard to copy well, easy to copy badly).

positioning_gaps.description: No ads/upsell/sales calls; every rule linked to official PDF page
positioning_gaps.evidence: Testbook Trustpilot sales-call complaints; clone-site and fake-notice warnings (v1 file).

positioning_gaps.description: Only paid tier in category would be INR 199/yr vs free everything
positioning_gaps.evidence: No competitor visibly monetizes alerts; the gap may exist because there is no WTP.

v2_vs_v1_note: Category saturation is unchanged (15/15). What improved: v2's exact combination (matching + persistence + lifecycle) has no direct app occupant, which lifts competition from 'high, no differentiation' toward 'high but differentiation opportunities exist'. What did not: the differentiation is feature-level (low defensibility) and at least five indie builders entered the eligibility/autofill angle in 2025-26.
differentiation_opportunities: Accuracy as the product: per-notification structured rules with a source link for every rule, versioned for corrigenda
Lifecycle tracker + clash detector across the user's own applications (nobody does this in-app)
Fold Form Pakka's pre-submit check into Pro (the only step with observed WTP)
